title: Compact row-tiling + conditional header rendering for scalable virtual tables
text:
Compact row-tiling + conditional header rendering for scalable virtual tables

description:
Proposal and spec for two complementary improvements to the table component library: (1) compact row-tiling — a density-driven layout that packs mixed-height rows into a visually consistent compact mode without truncation artifacts; (2) conditional header rendering — defer/render lightweight header placeholders outside of viewport to reduce paint cost in extremely wide, virtualized tables. Goal is to improve perceived density, reduce initial render jank, and keep keyboard/aria affordances intact.

goals:
Define interaction model for compact row-tiling that works with selection, keyboard navigation, and inline editing
Design header rendering strategy that can be gated by visibility and still support column-resize handles and accessible column controls
Create token mappings for density modes so compact mode is predictable across table variants and matches other components
Produce high-fidelity mockups and a handoff spec for engineering runtime changes to the virtualized table renderer

acceptance_criteria:
Compact mode reduces per-row height by >=20% for mixed-content rows without hiding important content by default
Header placeholders render in <16ms on average for 95th percentile table open in staging when using deferred rendering strategy
Column-resize affordance remains functional when header cells are rendered lazily; resizing updates live preview and persisted layout
Keyboard navigation (arrow keys, home/end, page up/down) works seamlessly in compact mode and when headers mount/unmount
Design tokens for density introduced with explicit mapping to existing spacing tokens and documented in the design system token page

decisions:
Use a tile-based packing heuristic for compact row-tiling (vertical pack into N compact lanes) instead of fixed clipping to preserve cell content context
Implement conditional header rendering at the header-cell granularity (not entire header row) so floating controls (sort/filter) can remain interactive
Expose a boolean prop 'deferHeaders' and a density token 'density.compact-tiling' to allow engineering safe rollout and feature flags
Keep ARIA roles unchanged; when header cells are unmounted replace with visually-hidden accessible placeholders to preserve semantics

risks:
Complexity in measuring mixed-content heights may introduce layout thrash if not memoized in the runtime
Edge cases with screen readers when header cells are deferred — requires QA with NVDA/VoiceOver
Performance improvements may vary widely across GPU/CPU on customer hardware; need conservative defaults and opt-in toggles
Interactions between column pinning and tile packing require additional rules to avoid visual overlap

tasks:
DES-901010 design: create tile packing variants and micro-interactions
ENG-24088 engineering: runtime memoized height estimator for compact-tiling
ENG-24089 engineering: conditional header API and accessibility shim
PM-43210 product: decide rollout gating and telemetry events
DES-901011 design: accessibility QA and annotated handoff frames

comments:
2026-03-02 Maya Chen: Initial draft posted to Confluence. Early exploration shows 18-25% height reduction on our reference dataset using packing heuristic.
2026-03-04 Arjun Patel: Reviewed Figma; suggested making selection band full-row-width in compact mode to improve discoverability. Will validate with engineering about selection painting cost.
2026-03-06 Ethan Ruiz (Engineering): Flagged potential reflow from unoptimized height measurement. Proposed adding a small cache keyed by row content hash.
2026-03-08 Accessibility review (Priya Nair): Screen reader semantics look good with visually-hidden placeholders but we need a test matrix for VoiceOver on macOS and Safari.
2026-03-10 Maya Chen: Incorporated feedback; handoff pack uploaded. Next steps: engineering spike (ENG-24088) and accessibility QA task scheduled for 2026-03-12.
2026-03-10 Arjun Patel: Added feature flag plan and telemetry events list to the Confluence page, linking to PM rollout ticket.
